title: Why delegation doesn't scale: hire people better than you and build teams
summary: Jason Cohen argues that founder-style "delegation" (do it, understand it, then hire someone to do it your way) yields a team no better than the founder. Real scale comes from hiring people better than you at every role, trusting teams to own outcomes, and building teams that themselves attract greatness, even replacing yourself as CEO.

principles.text: Delegation doesn't scale a business; building a team better than the current team, including you, does.
principles.quote: Delegation doesn't scale your business.  What does: Creating a team that is better than the current team.  Including you.

principles.text: Hiring someone who works like you only yields a substitute for your own non-world-class performance, not greatness.
principles.quote: When you're looking for someone who knows what you know, and works like you work, you're not finding greatness, you're finding a substitute for your already-not-world-class performance.

principles.text: A founder's or manager's job is to hire people who are better than them at every position.
principles.quote: To hire people who are better than you at every position**, because only then is your organization increasing its strength and abilities.

principles.text: Micromanaging or constantly fixing hires is bad management: either you hired wrong or you're blocking a capable person.
principles.quote: If the person isn't better than you at the position, you're not making the organization better. If the person is better than you, then your micromanagement is destroying that improvement while also destroying their morale and your schedule.

principles.text: Team-building means the team owns the outcome and its obligations; delegation leaves you owning it and as the bottleneck.
principles.quote: "Delegation" means you still own it but someone else does the work. "Team-building" means the team is trusted to own it, own its obligations, can figure out and execute the details

principles.text: No one is exempt, including the founder where they're excellent; aim to never be the most knowledgeable person in the room.
principles.quote: your goal is for you to never be the most knowledgeable and experienced person in the room, because you've surrounded yourself with greatness, who each do the same.
